_about: Public-domain Mother Mary Loyola (1845-1930) of the Bar Convent, York, English Catholic writer for children and communicants, for the Word Hoard: Questions on First Communion (1903), Before the Most Holy (Coram Sanctissimo, 1904), Jesus of Nazareth (1906), Heavenwards (1910) and Hail! Full of Grace (eighth edition, 1914), most edited by Herbert Thurston, from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mmloyola-before-the-most-holy: Before the Most Holy (Coram Sanctissimo), edited by Father Thurston, S.J. (St. Louis: B. Herder; London: Sands, 1904)

mmloyola-questions-first-communion: Questions on First Communion, with an introductory note by the Cardinal Archbishop of Westminster (London: Burns and Oates, 1903)
mmloyola-jesus-of-nazareth: Jesus of Nazareth: The Story of His Life Written for Children, edited by Father Thurston, S.J. (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1906)
mmloyola-heavenwards: Heavenwards, edited by Father Thurston, S.J. (New York and Philadelphia: P. J. Kenedy, 1910)
mmloyola-hail-full-of-grace: Hail! Full of Grace: Simple Thoughts on the Rosary, eighth edition, edited by Father Thurston, S.J. (St. Louis: B. Herder; London: Sands, 1914)

_alternates.mmloyola-copies: The IA Before the Most Holy (1904) and later editions (eleventh 1908, seventeenth undated); Hail! Full of Grace fourth edition (undated); Welcome! Holy Communion (undated)

_excluded.mmloyola-later: Trust (1932) and modern reprints; Thurston's Stations of the Cross (PG 79316)

_rights_checked.mmloyola-before-the-most-holy: PG header has no copyright marker; she died in 1930, so these pre-1930 books are US public domain and, at life plus 70, UK public domain since 2001

_pending.mmloyola-by-the-author-of: Confession and Communion (1900): title page reads only 'by the author of First Communion'
_pending.mmloyola-soldier-of-christ: The Soldier of Christ (undated Burns Oates & Washbourne impression, after about 1917): a pre-1930 printing is not proved
_pending.mmloyola-unfound: Questions on the Gospels: no scan found
